description: Source code for the NullDecrypter class implementing a no-op decryption mechanism in the QUIC protocol, including methods for setting keys, decrypting packets, and computing hashes.

classes.name: NullDecrypter
classes.description: A class implementing a null (no-op) decryption mechanism for QUIC packets, providing methods for key management, packet decryption, and hash computation.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided key is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Checks if the provided nonce prefix is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Checks if the provided IV is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Checks if the provided header protection key is empty; always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Should not be called; triggers a bug report and returns false.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Should not be called; triggers a bug report and returns true.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Reads hash from ciphertext, verifies it against computed hash, and copies plaintext to output if valid.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderProtectionMask
methods.description: Returns a string of five zero bytes as a placeholder mask.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefixSize
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no nonce prefix size.

methods.name: cipher_id
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating a null cipher ID.

methods.name: GetIntegrityLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for QuicPacketCount.

methods.name: ReadHash
methods.description: Reads a 128-bit hash from the data reader, combining two parts.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a 128-bit hash based on the perspective and input data, masking the result.
